home.ecosystem_citizen_title: Citizen Account — Simplify all your legal procedures
home.ecosystem_citizen_f1_d: Instant analysis of your contracts, personalized answers to your legal queries 24/7.
home.ecosystem_citizen_f2_d: Secure HD video consultations over 2 hours with specialized lawyers.
home.ecosystem_citizen_f3_d: Attend live video sessions with over 100 participants and access written summaries.

home.ecosystem_student_f1_d: Attend videoconferences hosted by Law Professors, Doctorate researchers, and Lawyers.
home.ecosystem_student_f2_d: Ask questions and interact directly with your mentors and professors.
home.ecosystem_student_f3_d: Unlimited access to legal research papers and PDF summaries.

home.ecosystem_student_f6_d: Gain visibility with law firms for internships and career opportunities.

home.ecosystem_prof_f2_d: Publish course modules and conferences to the interactive national calendar.
home.ecosystem_prof_f3_d: Submit research articles directly accessible to the public and student network.
home.ecosystem_prof_f4_d: Engage directly with students and trainees during live Q&A.

home.ecosystem_prof_f6_d: Collaborate with bar lawyers and doctorate researchers.

home.ecosystem_doc_f2_d: Organize methodology workshops and current affairs seminars.

home.ecosystem_doc_f4_d: Exchange with law professors and practicing attorneys.
home.ecosystem_doc_f5_d: Summarize French and international doctrine in seconds.
home.ecosystem_doc_f6_d: Export publications with official Academy PDF formatting.

home.ecosystem_lawyer_f1_d: Save time writing legal briefs and sifting through complex case files.
home.ecosystem_lawyer_f2_d: Host private consultations or live group video masterclasses.
home.ecosystem_lawyer_f3_d: Schedule sessions and legal updates on the public national calendar.
home.ecosystem_lawyer_f4_d: Publish legal research papers directly to the national scientific hub.
home.ecosystem_lawyer_f5_d: Issue real-time quotes, track clients, and manage fees securely.
home.ecosystem_lawyer_f6_d: Manage associates, paralegals, and trainees in a shared team space.
home.visio_title: 100% Secure Live HD Video Consultations & Classes
home.visio_desc: Attend group classes with over 100 attendees or book private HD video consultations. Past sessions automatically archive into comprehensive written summaries.
home.visio_bullet1: Unlimited Duration (over 2 hours per session without interruption).
home.visio_bullet2: Automatic archiving of past sessions into concise summaries.
home.visio_bullet3: Full interactivity with live chat, Q&A, and digital whiteboard.
home.visio_summary_desc: At the end of the 2-hour live stream, the room archives automatically into written summaries, cited laws, and Q&A takeaways.
home.planning_desc: Organize your masterclasses and meetings on a dynamic interconnected calendar. Past events remain accessible with full reports.
home.reviews_desc: Academic publishing space for Law Professors, Attorneys, and Doctorate Researchers. Download certified doctrine papers.
home.ai_section_desc: Ask queries in natural language, upload contract files, and receive detailed answers backed by Civil, Labor, and Commercial Codes.
